title: Symbolic: access to the MainSystem and the item functions
author: Claude-JG
description: revision2026c step RG12.4: inside a symbolic user function, read what the system has - e.g. the current position of a node, a sensor value - as symbolic expressions evaluated in C++.
releaseNotes: Symbolic user functions read other items: in a function recorded by CreateSymbolicUserFunction, mbs.GetNodeOutput, GetObjectOutput, GetObjectOutputBody, GetMarkerOutput and GetSensorValues are symbolic expressions, which C++ reads from the MainSystem at every call, with the same results as the Python function (a load reading a node, a body point, a marker, a sensor and a connector about 9 times faster); a scalar output is a symbolic Real, the others a Vector; every other attribute of mbs raises an AttributeError while recording, as its value would be a constant of the recording. Such a function is evaluated in the main thread.
